program.name: Calm Floor
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: Calm strength with no gear: Pilates or back care, slow bodyweight lifts, then yin.
program.about: Calm strength on the floor. One day opens with a Pilates series, the other with back-care core; both move on to slow push-ups, squats, bridges and floor pulls, and close with long yin holds. No equipment needed. Level II slows every rep down and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Pilates, slow bodyweight & yin / back care, slow bodyweight & yin
